overall: The AG resolved the complaint by informal action, finding no violation because the Board never met in executive session on the noticed topic. It declined to rule on the hypothetical deliberation and cautioned that Purpose 6 is narrowly construed.

allegations.summary: Notice for a May 23 meeting listed a Purpose 6 executive session on bylaw amendments about select board licenses for town property; the board did not convene in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Instead, because the Board did not actually meet in executive session on May 23, we find that it did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant asked the AG to determine whether a hypothetical executive session deliberation on the noticed purpose would have violated the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Ms. Shea does not dispute these facts, but rather asks our office to determine that had the Board deliberated in executive session for the above purpose
